# Suriname — problems

- Found: ABS statistical yearbook tables "Aantal geregistreerde moord en doodslag gevallen per district" for 2010–2018 across four editions (10 districts + total; murder and manslaughter separately). Every edition is kept as its own source_key, so overlapping years appear more than once (later editions carry revised figures, marked # in the table). Pick one edition per year when mapping.
- District sums match the published totals in every edition and year (checked by script).
- Blanks: Para 2015 manslaughter is blank in all editions; Paramaribo 2016 is blank in the 2016/2017 edition (revised to 13 / 6 in later editions). "-" = nil (written as 0, note says so); "." = data not available (Sipaliwini 2010–2011; left blank).
- 2018 figures (2018/2019 edition) look unusual (Marowijne 14 murders, Para 12 and Saramacca 6 manslaughter, total doodslag 45) but are as published.
- The 2020–2022 yearbook (Dec 2023) has no crime chapter; only deaths by district of residence (all causes). No district figures after 2018 found. The Korps Politie Suriname figures reported in the press (e.g. keynews.sr, 42 "halsdelicten" Jan–Aug 2023) are national only.
